calculation_handling.description: The GFA of an ancillary building containing a garden suite is excluded from the lot's total GFA and FSI.
calculation_handling.gaps: Exclusion rule for the FSI / GFA measurement of the lot; names fsi as the variable it shapes.

calculation_handling.description: The GFA of the garden suite building must be less than the GFA of the residential building on the lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: A relative maximum (garden suite GFA < main building GFA): gfa_m2 is the suite building's own target and there is no DSL input for the main residential building's GFA, so no numeric_expression can be written.

units.disclosure: A garden suite must be smaller (in gross floor area) than the main house on the lot; we do not compare the two.

calculation_handling.description: The general maximum floor area for ancillary buildings in 10.5.60.50(2) does not apply to an ancillary building containing a garden suite.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces 10.5.60.50(2) for garden suite buildings; displaces[] is not a keyed field here.

calculation_handling.description: The maximum GFA of an ancillary building containing a garden suite is 120 m2.
Despite (4)(A), a one-storey garden suite building may have at most 60 m2 GFA.
calculation_handling.gaps: "one storey" written as a word, normalized to 1 storeys; the condition reads the suite building's storey count (height_storeys), under building_height_band as the nearest threshold token. Whether the suite is one storey is a design choice.

calculation_handling.description: The GFA of a garden suite building may be reduced by the areas listed in 10.5.40.40(1), (2) and (3)(A) and (B) (GFA exclusions).
calculation_handling.gaps: Measurement rule incorporating the exclusion list in 10.5.40.40; could also be read as INCLUDE. The excluded areas depend on the suite design.

150.7.60.50(1).explanation: A garden suite building does not count toward the lot's total gross floor area or floor space index.

150.7.60.50(2).explanation: A garden suite must have less gross floor area than the main house on the lot.

150.7.60.50(3).explanation: The general floor area cap for sheds and other ancillary buildings does not apply to a building containing a garden suite.

150.7.60.50(4).explanation: A garden suite building may have up to 120 m2 of gross floor area, or up to 60 m2 if it is one storey.

150.7.60.50(5).explanation: When calculating a garden suite's gross floor area, the same areas excluded for other buildings under 10.5.40.40 may be left out.
